THE PITCH IS YOURS

One keeper.
All afternoon.

No clock. Find a little space, pick your corner, and have a go.

01 / FIND YOUR SPOT
Move with WASD or the arrow keys. The ball stays at your feet, and movement follows the screen.
02 / PICK YOUR CORNER
Aim with the mouse. The dotted line follows the ground; aim at the base of the goal. Q and E also turn your aim.
03 / HAVE A GO
Hold Space to build power, then release to kick. Press C to switch between a low shot and a chip. Chips can clear the keeper, but too much power can send them over the bar.

Esc cancels a charged shot or pauses. The ball returns after each attempt. Stats last for this visit. Best played with a keyboard and mouse.
